name: prompt-injections-benchmark-chinese
description: A Chinese-language prompt injection benchmark that measures LLM vulnerability to malicious or distracting instructions embedded in prompts and the model's ability to refuse or sanitize such instructions. It contains attack/benign examples in Chinese and evaluates detection/refusal and safe response generation behaviors. Useful for evaluating instruction-following safety and adversarial robustness in Chinese LLMs.
reputation: Relatively new and specialized; modest community usage for Chinese prompt-injection research and safety testing.
